cites.quote: adds the next appointment (id, start, doctor name) to each list item, or leaves it empty
Lists answer `{ items, page, page_size, total }`, 20 per page.

findings.text: The design widens GET /api/patients but never defines the new list item fields: names, types, UTC instant format, or how 'no next appointment' is represented (null vs absent). The client type and PatientsPage depend on this contract.
